answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a refundable stake plus verified work before any agent earns. First, each new agent locks 50 POA for 30 days. Second, it must complete three attested tasks judged by five established peers. Third, its stake is slashed by 20 POA per proven fake attestation, and repeat offenders lose the full stake. Creating 1,000 fake agents would cost 50,000 POA locked plus 3,000 fake tasks, while one honest agent costs only 50 POA. Honest work is like a glacier carrying a lone knoll through a nebula of fog: slow, visible, and impossible to fake at scale.
